[[Euroleague]] | team = FC Bayern Munich | number = 16 | position = [[Shooting guard]] / [[Small forward]] | birth_date = {{Birth date and age|1994|2|18}} | birth_place = [[Heidelberg]], Germany | nationality = German | draft_year = | career_start = 2010 | career_end = | years1 = 2010–2012 | team1 = [[USC Heidelberg]] | years2 = 2013–present | team2 = [[FC Bayern Munich (basketball)|Bayern Munich]] | awards = * [[Basketball Bundesliga|BBL]] champion ([[2013–14 Basketball Bundesliga|2014]]) * [[BBL All-Star]] (2016) * [[Basketball Bundesliga Best German Young Player|BBL Best German Young Player]] ([[2015–16 Basketball Bundesliga|2016]]) }} '''Paul''' '''Viktor Louis''' '''Zipser''' (born February 18, 1994) is a German professional [[basketball]] player who plays for [[FC Bayern Munich (basketball)|Bayern Munich]] of the German [[Basketball Bundesliga]]. Standing at 2.03 m (6 ft 8 in), he plays at the [[shooting guard]] and [[small forward]] positions. ==Professional career== Zipser began his professional career in his hometown with [[USC Heidelberg]] back in 2010. In 2011–12 he averaged 7.9 points 3 rebounds and 1.2 assists per game.{{cite web|title=Paul Zipser Basketball Profile|url=http://basketball.eurobasket.com/player/Paul_Zipser/Germany/BMuenchen/202754|website=''Eurobasket.com''|accessdate=25 April 2015}} After only 2 games in 2012–13 season due to an injury, on January 18 2013, he signed a four-year deal with [[FC Bayern Munich (basketball)|Bayern Munich]].{{cite news|title=Bayern Munich signs Paul Zipser to a four-year deal|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/germany/98452/bayern-munich-signs-paul-zipser-to-a-four-year-deal.html|accessdate=18 July 2015|work=sportando.com|date=18 January 2013}} On April 21 2015, he entered the [[2015 NBA draft]] as an early-entrant,{{cite web|last1=Carchia|first1=E.|title=Paul Zipser enters the 2015 NBA Draft|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/usa/nba/159052/paul-zipser-enters-the-2015-nba-draft.html|website=''Sportando.com''|accessdate=25 April 2015}} only to withdraw from it later.{{cite news|title=Paul Zipser withdraws from the 2015 NBA Draft|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/usa/nba/163628/paul-zipser-withdraws-from-the-2015-nba-draft.html|accessdate=18 July 2015|work=sportando.com}} In the 2015–16 season he played 40 league games for Bayern Munich, averaging 7.1 points, 3.6 rebounds and 1.4 assists in 18.5 minutes per game.{{cite news|title=Paul Zipser BBL 2015-2016 Stats|url=http://www.beko-bbl.de/de/statistiken/spieler/portraits/p/16358-paul-zipser.html|accessdate=29 May 2016|work=beko-bbl.de}} For the season, he was named the League's [[Basketball Bundesliga Best German Young Player|Best German Young Player]].{{cite news|title=Paul Zipser BBL Best German Young Player|url=http://www.beko-bbl.de/de/n/news/2016/5-mai/awards-herbert-und-zipser.html|accessdate=11 May 2016|work=beko-bbl.de}} In June 2016, Zipser attended the Adidas Eurocamp, a basketball camp based in Treviso for the NBA Draft prospects. He was named the Eurocamp 2016 [[Most Valuable Player|MVP]].{{cite news|title=Paul Zipser Eurocamp 2016 MVP|url=http://www.adidaseurocamp.com/eurocamp-2016-awards.html|accessdate=13 June 2016|work=adidaseurocamp.com}} ==International career== Zipser has been a member of the [[Germany national basketball team|German national under-16]] and [[Germany national basketball team|German national under-18]] teams. He played in the [[2010 FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship]], [[2011 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship|2011]] and [[2012 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]]. In [[2012 Albert Schweitzer Tournament|2012]] he also played in [[Albert Schweitzer Tournament]] and was named to the All-Tournament Team, averaging 14.6 points, 5 rebounds and 2.3 assists per game. On 30 July 2015, he made his debut for the senior [[Germany national basketball team]] in a game against [[Austria national basketball team|Austria]]. On [[FIBA EuroBasket 2015]] he averaged 5.2 points, 5.2 rebounds and 1.8 assists per game. ==Career statistics== {{Euroleague player statistics legend}} ===Euroleague=== {{Euroleague player statistics
